solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Public house, very large, repeatedly holding RU match needs this

definitions.note: a descriptive phrase standing for the substance

indicators.note: to hold something is to keep it within, so the final pair wraps around the next letters

blocks.note: PH is the map abbreviation for a public house
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size
the same pair of abbreviations comes round a second time
taken as written; RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: A rugby union fixture played near a big pub seems to need something, read as a sporting match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Repeatedly' means the pub and size abbreviations both come round twice. The 'match' is not a sporting contest but the thing you strike to light a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Match heads contain a chemical compound of the element that ignites by friction, so a match depends on it.

clue.text: Respected hotel everyone was in debt to

blocks.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a plain synonym
to owe is to be in debt to someone

explanation.surface: A guest who once owed money to a hotel is now honoured there.
explanation.definitionFit: Hallowed means held in reverence, so it is a stronger synonym for respected or venerated.

clue.text: Notes appeal for help

blocks.note: first meaning: the plural of a note of the sol-fa scale
second meaning: the international distress signal

explanation.surface: A written plea asking someone for assistance.
explanation.walkthrough: SO (or soh) is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale, so two of them are SOS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Morse distress signal is the standard call for rescue, while the musical syllable pluralised gives the same letters.

clue.text: Pigeon house on lake left incomplete

indicators.note: leaving something incomplete means its final letter is dropped

blocks.note: HO is the abbreviation for house
a mere is a small lake

explanation.surface: A pigeon's loft by a lake has been left unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: Mere is an old and poetic word for a lake, common in English place names.
explanation.definitionFit: A homer is a homing pigeon, a bird bred to fly back to its loft.

clue.text: Prepare for painting buff and blue

blocks.note: to buff a surface is to rub or polish it
feeling blue is feeling low or depressed

explanation.surface: Instructions for prepping a surface, perhaps choosing a buff and blue colour scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: Buff and blue look like paint colours, but buff is a verb and blue means sad.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanding or smoothing a surface before a fresh coat is the standard preparation for decorating.

clue.text: Cruel don's going badly rogue

indicators.note: things going badly are going wrong, so these letters end up in a disordered arrangement

blocks.note: the letters of both words, apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A harsh university tutor behaving badly is called a rogue.
explanation.definitionFit: A scoundrel is a dishonest or unprincipled person, the same as a rogue.

clue.text: Desire to get rid of … to get rid of piano

indicators.note: getting rid of something removes it, so the musical piano letter is taken away

blocks.note: to purge is to get rid of something

explanation.surface: A deliberately repetitive line about the wish to be rid of something, then of a piano.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'to get rid of' is a synonym; the repeated phrase then removes P, the musical abbreviation for piano (soft).
explanation.definitionFit: An urge is a strong wish or impulse, the same as a desire used as a noun.

clue.text: Uncalled for as one introduces songs for one Conservative

indicators.note: to introduce something is to put it inside, so one item goes into another
for here means in place of, so one letter swaps out for another

blocks.note: acting as one is acting united
soli is a plural of solo, a song for one voice
the Roman numeral for one
C is the standard abbreviation for Conservative

explanation.surface: A singer's unrequested performance, with a Tory swapping in for someone.
explanation.walkthrough: The songs go inside 'as one', and then the Conservative takes the place of one of the two adjacent I's that results.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unsolicited was not requested or asked for, hence uncalled for.

clue.text: Large house with good open area of land

blocks.note: G is the abbreviation for good
a range is an extensive stretch of open grazing land

explanation.surface: An estate agent's description of a big home with grounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A grange is a country house with farm buildings, a substantial rural residence.

clue.text: Organised activity for many an American fool covered in excess fat

indicators.note: something covered in a layer sits inside it, so these letters go within the outer word

blocks.note: flab is surplus body fat
a shmo is American slang for a stupid person

explanation.surface: A US idiot wrapped in a lot of fat is set up as a crowd event.
explanation.walkthrough: The fool goes in after the third letter of the fat. Shmo, also spelt schmo, comes from Yiddish.
explanation.definitionFit: A flash mob is a crowd gathering arranged online to perform a sudden act in public, a coordinated event involving many people.

clue.text: So-called poet emerging from Vienna is soliciting backing

indicators.note: emerging from means coming out of a run of words, so the letters lie within them
backing means going backwards, so the found letters are read right to left

blocks.note: the end of Vienna, all of is and the start of soliciting

explanation.surface: A poet emerging from Vienna seeking support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'So-called' is fair because Ossian, the ancient Gaelic bard, was largely invented by James Macpherson in the 1760s.
explanation.definitionFit: Ossian is the legendary bard whose supposed epics Macpherson published, so he is a poet only in name.

clue.text: Losing face, one looking to buy container

indicators.note: the face is the front, so losing it drops the opening letter

blocks.note: someone out to make purchases

explanation.surface: An embarrassed customer looking to purchase a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A hopper is a funnel-shaped receptacle for grain or coal that is fed out from the bottom.

clue.text: Greek character behind catalogue is a collector

blocks.note: phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
behind schedule is late
a plain synonym

explanation.surface: A Greek figure trailing behind a sales catalogue turns out to be an enthusiast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Behind' looks like a placing instruction but is a synonym for late.
explanation.definitionFit: A philatelist collects postage stamps, making the term a specific kind of collector.

clue.text: Old opera company record unknown for wine producers' scholarship?

blocks.note: O is the abbreviation for old
ENO is English National Opera
a log is a written record
y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: An opera company's old recording, mysteriously used to fund a vintner's study grant.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is loose: the field is the study of wine itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Oenology is the science of winemaking, the learning that a vintner draws on.

clue.text: Contrived Orient cliché describing the solar system

indicators.note: something contrived is artificially arranged, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: every letter of both words

explanation.surface: A tired Eastern stereotype artificially used to describe the planets.
explanation.definitionFit: Our planetary system has the Sun at its centre, which is what the adjective means.

clue.text: Call from queen to provide food with gold all in the middle

indicators.note: only the central letter of the short word is wanted

blocks.note: to cater is to supply food
W is the abbreviation for with
Au is the chemical symbol for gold
the middle letter of the three

explanation.surface: A monarch calls for food to be served, with gold everywhere in the centre.
explanation.walkthrough: The queen is not a monarch but a female cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A caterwaul is the wailing cry of a cat on heat, and a queen is a breeding female cat.

clue.text: Give notice on account of eastern conflict ending in revolution

indicators.note: the ending of a word is its final letter, so only that is kept

blocks.note: for meaning because of
E is the abbreviation for eastern
a plain synonym
the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A warning issued because of an Eastern war that ended in an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: To forewarn is to alert someone in advance, giving them advance notice.

clue.text: Joint delivery of speech

blocks.note: first meaning: a point where bones or parts are hinged together
second meaning: the clear pronunciation of words

explanation.surface: Reads as a joint statement being delivered.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an anatomical hinge between bones and the clear enunciation of spoken sounds.

clue.text: Think of a number one's going to score

definitions.text: Think of a number one's going to score

blocks.clueFragment: Think of a number one's going to score
blocks.note: surface reading: a maths trick, picking a number and reaching twenty
setter's reading: a number is a song, and a score is written music, so this is creating a piece

explanation.surface: A party arithmetic game where you pick a number to reach a score of twenty.
explanation.walkthrough: Score means twenty in counting, but here it is written music.
explanation.definitionFit: Composers devise a musical piece and write out its orchestral score, so the verb fits creating a song.

clue.text: Page that is about traitor and main criminal

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the pair of letters goes round the next word

blocks.note: P is the abbreviation for page
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is
a rat is someone who betrays comrades

explanation.surface: A page about a traitor who is also a leading crook.
explanation.walkthrough: The main is the sea, as in Spanish Main, so a main criminal is a seagoing one.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirate robs ships on the high seas, and 'the main' is an old word for the open ocean.

clue.text: Member of orchestra was partial suspect?

blocks.note: to side with someone is to take their part
rum is British slang for odd or questionable

explanation.surface: An orchestral player was biased and seems under suspicion.
explanation.walkthrough: The member is an instrument, not a musician; rum is old British slang for strange.
explanation.definitionFit: A side drum, or snare drum, is part of an orchestra's percussion section.

clue.text: Friend in New York to receive allowance

blocks.note: bud is American slang for a friend
a plain synonym

explanation.surface: A New York pal is getting pocket money.
explanation.definitionFit: A budget is the sum of money set aside for a purpose, an allocation like an allowance.

clue.text: British remain in port

blocks.note: B is the abbreviation for British
the rest is what remains

explanation.surface: A Briton stays on in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like a container signal, but it only links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Brest is a major naval port in Brittany, north-west France.

clue.text: Film of father with girl

blocks.note: pa is an informal word for father
a girl's name

explanation.surface: A home movie of a dad and his daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: Film is a thin coating, not a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: A patina is a thin layer or sheen formed on metal or wood over time.

clue.text: Ended chief's expense

blocks.note: something ended is over
a head is a chief; the possessive simply joins to the definition

explanation.surface: The boss's spending has stopped.
explanation.definitionFit: An overhead is a running business cost such as rent, a regular expense.

clue.text: Lobster perhaps beheaded at that time

indicators.note: losing the head means the first letter is removed

blocks.note: when meaning at the time that

explanation.surface: A lobster that was decapitated back then.
explanation.definitionFit: Hen is the name for a female lobster, as for many female birds and crustaceans, so lobster is an example.

clue.text: Handy pottery left out

indicators.note: out means removed, so that letter is dropped from the word

blocks.note: delft is glazed earthenware from the Dutch town of that name
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Useful pottery has been left outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Deft means skilful with the hands, the sense of handy meaning adept.

clue.text: Officer having to fabricate utility vehicle with new soldier?

blocks.note: to fabricate a story is to lie
ute is Australian slang for a utility truck or pickup
N is the abbreviation for new
a soldier ant is a kind of ant, so soldier stands for ant

explanation.surface: An officer forced to falsify paperwork about a truck with a fresh recruit.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that soldier is an example: a soldier is one caste of ant.
explanation.definitionFit: A lieutenant is a junior commissioned officer in the army or navy.
